title: Speaking — Ordering your day
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on ordering your day.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
Do you use a list to plan your day?
Which tasks do you normally put off until later?

part2.topic: Describe a day when a simple plan saved you considerable time.
points: which part of the plan helped the most
part2.closing: and explain why you would plan a similar day in the same way.

questions: When is a flexible schedule more valuable than a detailed plan?
Why are time-saving services easier for some people to use than others?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to ordering your day?
